SEN.note: Only property censuses for tax, not a population census or household survey.
Document states nothing on local office connections.
The tax directorate and Treasury hold property tax records and collection centrally; no municipal revenue record stated.

facts.fact: LoGRI says Senegal's tax directorate DGID uses an IT system, SIGUIL, to manage taxpayer data for property taxation, with a successor SIGUIL 2 deployed in ongoing property censuses.
